text: Among glaciology projects that started in 2021 or later, what evaluation score did the assessment panel award the proposal of the project that trains a new generation of early-stage researchers around the deep Antarctic ice core drilled by the Beyond EPICA campaign?

absence_evidence.sql: SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE lower(column_name) LIKE '%score%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%evalu%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%panel%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%rank%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%grade%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%mark%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%assess%' OR lower(column_name) LIKE '%review%'
absence_evidence.key_result: No column in ANY table of the database carries an evaluation / score / panel / ranking / assessment / review facet - the schema has no structured place to store a proposal evaluation score.

reference_answer: The database carries no proposal-evaluation facet: no table or column in it holds an evaluation, score, panel or ranking field, and none of the seven glaciology projects starting in 2021 or later - including the one meant here, DEEPICE (grant 955750) - records a score anywhere in its title, objective or report sections. What is stored for DEEPICE is its status (CLOSED), its funding (ecMaxContribution EUR 4,166,057.88, totalCost EUR 4,166,057.88) and its free-text objective and report, so the evaluation score its proposal received cannot be answered from this data.
notes: ABSENCE CLAIM (scoped to what was executed): the schema carries no evaluation/score/panel/ranking/assessment/review column in any table, and none of the 7 filter survivors - DEEPICE included - records a proposal score anywhere in title, objective, teaser, summary, workPerformed or finalResults under a wide score-phrasing set; so the score awarded to DEEPICE's proposal is unavailable. SCOPE DISCLOSURE (raised by the critic, upheld by the judge): the corpus at large is NOT free of proposal scores. Nine projects state their own score in stored text - objective: 696898 WELL 'achieving a total score of 12,88', 717497 ECOBREW2 'evaluated with a score of 12.81 and awarded with the Seal of Excellence', 728455 SAP-Nano 'a total score of 12,84', 739013 Smart OEE 'with a total score of 13.95', 744040 ECOMOBI 'the Seal of Excellence label ... with a score of 13.28', 761883 MePlat 'received a score of 13.71', 954038 ROBOHARVEST 'a Seal of Excellence and a score of 13.88'; report_text: 763635 MedSTACH 'The MedSTACH proposal was ranked 1st (score of 15/15) on a pan-European scale, among 208 proposals', 101029605 SAFE-FACE '15/15 perfect score'. The same aggregate finds 84 rows containing 'seal of excellence' and 15 containing 'evaluation panel'. None of these is a glaciology 2021+ survivor and none is DEEPICE; the string 'DEEPICE' appears only in project 955750. The absence this question depends on is therefore stated at two proven scopes only - no column anywhere, and no score text for these 7 survivors - never as a corpus-wide claim that no project records a score. The two corpus-wide typed claims are exact-string claims about the phrase 'evaluation score' and say so in their key_result. PARENT AND EDIT: twin hyb-01 ('Among glaciology projects that started in 2021 or later, what past climatic change does the project that trains a new generation of early-stage researchers around the deep Antarctic ice core drilled by the Beyond EPICA campaign aim to help explain?'). Exactly one thing changed: the asked facet. The structured filter (glaciology euroSciVoc subtree AND startDate >= 2021-01-01) and the identifying textual clause are word-for-word the parent's; 'what past climatic change ... aim to help explain' became 'what evaluation score did the assessment panel award the proposal of'. The parent's filter re-executed to exactly its 7 recorded survivors including gold 955750. SUBTYPE FIT (data-absent, not zero-match): the referent exists and is uniquely identifiable - the filter returns 7 rows, DEEPICE is one of them, and it is retrievable (pooled search on the question text ranks 955750 #1 in all four conditions). What is missing is the FACET for that referent, not the instance: no column could hold it and no survivor text carries it. NEAR-NAME COLUMNS (the trap): project carries status, ecMaxContribution, totalCost, topics/masterCall/subCall, and organization carries ecContribution - money and call metadata sit right next to the asked-for score, so a system that does not distinguish 'funded amount' or 'call topic' from 'evaluation score' will answer with a number instead of refusing. Probing the natural column name returns an error, recorded as evidence: SELECT evaluationScore FROM project WHERE id = 955750 -> 'BinderException: Binder Error: Referenced column "evaluationScore" not found in FROM clause! Candidate bindings: "fundingScheme", "humanValidated", "ecSignatureDate", "grantDoi", "objective"'. FREE-TEXT SPOT-CHECK (search_corpus, condition=pooled, k=20, index be84cbad9182) on 'evaluation score awarded by the evaluation panel to the DEEPICE proposal, glaciology training network Beyond EPICA Antarctic ice core': the top hit is 955750 DEEPICE itself (lexical/dense/hybrid/hybrid_rerank rank 1), whose returned chunk is its objective ('DEEPICE aims to train a new generation of European researcher (15 ESRs)...') and carries no score; the rest are ice-core/Antarctic science projects (815384 Beyond EPICA, 817493 ICORDA, 730258 BE-OI, 790280 GOLD-ICE, 889508 SCADI, 656381 SHARP, 667507 deepSLice, 800204 VEILA, 657187 REVEAL, 845115 ICELEARNING, 841073 POLARISO, 841980 ANTICE, 101018266 MICRO-CLIMATE, 101023960 ICEglobe, 742224 WACSWAIN, 820575 TiPACCs, 856416 DEEP PURPLE, 787263 PALGLAC, 747336 BRISRES, 792773 WAMSISE, 864637 ANTSIE, 661015 OceanIS, 694188 GlobalMass, 101020356 DEFCOMANT) plus topical strays pulled by the word 'evaluation'/'deep' (805550 FluidKnowledge - an ethnography of how evaluation shapes ocean science, no project's score; 955606 DEEP-SEA; 819155 EPIC; 890778 GraphNeT; 678760 ATLAS; 657050 RES.CO.PART - a shortlisting for an MSCA prize, not a proposal evaluation score; 657357 WINTERC-3D; 739741 ADMS). Every candidate is OFF-FACET: none states an evaluation score for any proposal. NEAR-MISS DISCLOSURE: a broader survivor-text sweep including bare '%grade%' and '%ranked%' returned one row, 101030314 MOTKA, matched on 'grade' as a substring (no 'ranked' match); the facet-specific queries are empty and MOTKA is not the question's referent. A corpus-wide objective sweep for 'evaluation panel' OR 'evaluation summary report' returns 5 projects - 764466/811195/857996/101000021 (all ERC VP CSA, projects whose SUBJECT is running ERC evaluation panels) and 733723 CLEARSILVER (an 'evaluation summary report' as a deliverable) - none of them a survivor. ROUTE COSTUME (hybrid/scoped): the question carries a structured filter a router can execute (glaciology classification + start year) and a textual identification clause that can only be settled by reading the survivors' free text - the same shape as its parent, a hybrid-route bank question. schema_docs sd2 f8c001e8cc8f; index_fingerprint be84cbad9182.
